title: Statistical analysis report, R code, and processed data for: Cell cycle dynamics of synthetic mRNA-induced β-cell proliferation
description:
This repository contains the R statistical analysis code, processed analysis-ready flow cytometry data, and rendered statistical report accompanying the manuscript Cell cycle dynamics of synthetic mRNA induced β-cell proliferation.

The repository includes the processed Excel data used as input for the statistical analyses, together with R code for data visualization, linear mixed-effects modelling, model diagnostics, omnibus tests, pairwise comparisons, and generation of the statistical report.

Original raw data underlying the findings reported in the manuscript will be shared by the lead contact upon reasonable request.

Original GitHub repository: https://github.com/filip-tichanek/beta_cells. Rendered statistical report: https://filip-tichanek.github.io/beta_cells/.
